design: matched-seed control versus feedback under five duplicate-overlap exclusion rules; identical rules, seeds and hyperparameters on both sides

scenarios.B_no_test_duplicates: duplicate rows inside KDDTest+ removed from evaluation
scenarios.C_no_train_overlap: test rows whose feature vector also occurs in KDDTrain+ removed
scenarios.E_strict_cross_fold: D, plus cross-fold duplicate rows excluded from evaluation and from the feedback set

fold_split: StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) over the test set
note_on_ranges: Across-seed minimum and maximum describe run-to-run variation of the random forest; they are not confidence intervals. Wilson 95% intervals reported inside each scenario are the statistical intervals for a single run's counts.
